proposed.text: When a government architect evaluates BIM, green-building, or universal-design practices for an in-house office, what is the source-safe approach?

options.text: Treat every innovation as mandatory under RA 9266 even without a cited rule
Ignore new technical standards because public agencies use only internal memos
Adopt useful tools only through the applicable law, code, agency standard, or approved project requirement, and cite that source for the specific element
Use RA 9184 as the technical design code for accessibility and fire safety

proposed.rationale: Identify the controlling law, technical code, agency standard, or project requirement for the element being designed.
proposed.explanation: The parent article supports RA 9266 responsibility and technical-code compliance while avoiding unsupported BIM or green-building mandate claims.
proposed.code_citation: RA 9266 IRR; applicable project technical codes and agency standards when separately verified
